consumption_rules.insufficient_or_conflicting: unresolved, not a confirmed content error
consumption_rules.limits: one relation, two findings, one check, at most one revision
consumption_rules.overreach+deny: limit C; preserve the supported part of P
consumption_rules.sufficient+support: retain the inference within its stated conditions
consumption_rules.target: reanchor only if T=deny AND TB=different_G_C with bound G/C evidence
consumption_rules.unknown: method/relationship uncertainty does not block unrelated supported work
